title: myrobalanus porphyrocarpa
intro: Myrobalanus porphyrocarpa, commonly known as the Indian gooseberry or amla, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. The health benefits of Myrobalanus porphyrocarpa include its ability to support immune function, act as an antioxidant, and help lower cholesterol levels. Therapeutically, it is used to treat various conditions, including fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Myrobalanus porphyrocarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
